youtube_short.title: Your Commute Is Stealing $12,800 a Year
title_alternatives: The Real Cost of Your Daily Commute (Nobody Talks About This)
Your Morning Drive Is Costing You $2.2 Million
youtube_short.description: Your morning commute feels normal — but when you do the full math, it's quietly draining $12,800 a year. The IRS mileage rate on your car alone runs $5,360. Add commute coffees, office lunches, and work clothes — that's another $2,200. And if you'd invested that $12,800 instead for 30 years at 10%? That's $2.2 million. Your commute is a financial decision. #commute #personalfinance #moneytips #financialfreedom #moneymath
